column1: # Sticker photo sources — paste the Pexels photo URL into the `url` column.
#   1. Click the search link, browse, pick a photo you like.
#      and paste it in the last column. Tab-separated.
#   3. Leave `url` blank for any you haven't chosen yet — the scripts skip those.
#   4. Tell Claude, and it runs: npm run fetch:stickers && npm run prepare:stickers
# WHAT MAKES A GOOD STICKER PHOTO
#   ✅ ONE subject, filling most of the frame, in focus
#   ✅ Background clearly separable (the subject gets cut out for the silhouette)
#   ✅ A real photograph — NOT an illustration, 3D render, figurine, or wooden toy
#   ❌ Subject small in a wide scene · multiple subjects · subject cropped at the edge
# --- 2a: letter-initial animals (19) — picture starts with the lesson's consonant ---
